notes: Layout alignment. Two Half tiles now share a column even when their widths differ - previously the pairing silently required matching widths, so a Large curtain beside a Small roller refused to pair and each one filled a whole column at full height, which is what turned the row into mismatched slabs. The climate band no longer leaves a card-shaped hole when an odd number of rooms is reporting: the last card spans instead. A roller's grip pill sits inside its bottom rail rather than straddling it, which put it outside the card whenever the shutter was fully closed. And DEFAULT_PAIRS is empty: pulling the roller next to the curtain also handed it the curtain's room, which merged the bedroom into the living room's row and made it impossible to start a new row there.
